title: Case study: a wellness brand, real content versus aspirational
hook: An Ayurvedic supplements brand put real content against aspirational content. The uplift was 2.6×.
caption:
An Ayurvedic supplements brand put real content against aspirational content. The uplift was 2.6×.

Wellness ads often lean polished. The open question was whether buyers trust that, or something closer to their own life.

For this brand, real won. Its results with Galvor: +91% RoAS and +135% hold rate (anonymised client, galvor.ai/results).

One brand is a signal, so test it in your own category. The last slide shows how to set it up fairly: same product, same offer, same claim, two looks.

Save it and follow @galvor.ai.
